subject: Acme FinTech - Redwood evaluation & procurement timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-fintech.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme FinTech - Redwood evaluation & procurement timeline

Great speaking with you this morning — thanks for the time, Jordan. Quick recap and proposed next steps from today's discovery call: 

- Goal: evaluate Redwood for customer-facing LLM features (chat + summarization) with a production rollout target in Q2.
- Decision criteria you called out: latency under 250ms p50, predictable unit cost, SOC 2 + data residency controls, and easy model pinning for canary rollouts.
- Immediate asks for procurement: vendor onboarding form, sample PO terms (net days, invoicing), and Redwood's W-9/bank details.
- Stakeholders I have so far: you (product lead), Samantha Lee (economic buyer - VP Product & Engineering), Alan Chu (legal), Priya Shah (procurement). Please flag anyone I'm missing.

Next steps / proposed owners:
1) Jordan — confirm economic buyer + procurement contact (who will own PO).
2) Acme procurement — complete vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx and send any required vendor documents we should complete.
3) Redwood (me + Rishi) — share MSA draft, security packet, and sample invoice/PO terms. Rishi will cover technical SSO/data questions.
4) Schedule procurement kickoff for next week if that works (I proposed Wed/Thu below).

Attachments: Acme_Redwood_MSA_draft.pdf (draft), vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (blank), redwood_security_packet.pdf (summary + SOC 2 scope).

Proposed times for a 30-min procurement kickoff: Wed 2027-04-07 10:00-11:00 PT or Thu 2027-04-08 14:00-15:00 PT. Let me know what works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acme-fintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-fintech.com>, Alan Chu <alan.chu@acme-fintech.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme FinTech - Redwood evaluation & procurement timeline

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Samantha Lee (VP Product & Engineering) — she'll own the final approval on budget.
- Procurement contact: that is Priya Shah (cc'd Priya on other threads; she handles vendor onboarding and PO).
- Legal: Alan Chu will handle MSA redlines — he asked to review your draft and return comments by next Tue if possible.

Decision criteria (adding a couple specifics you can include in the SOW/notes):
- Throughput: support for ~30 QPS at ~2k token windows without large latency spikes.
- SLAs: prefer 99.9% availability target; fallback options if a region or model variant degrades.
- Data handling: confirm that customer request content is not used to train public models and that logs are sequestered per contract.

Procurement timeline: Priya is aiming to have vendor onboarding completed and PO issued by the first two weeks of May. The internal timeline is: 
- Legal review of MSA: by 2027-04-09 (Alan)
- Procurement/vendor onboarding: 2027-04-12 to 2027-04-26
- PO issuance target: 2027-05-06

I've attached the completed vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (filled with basic company info) and flagged the question about W-9 and bank details — will you be able to share those? Also attaching a brief vendor requirements checklist (not included in metadata) for your reference.

Jordan
Product Lead, Acme FinTech
jordan.myers@acme-fintech.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acme-fintech.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme FinTech - Redwood evaluation & procurement timeline

Thanks Jordan — and thanks for the filled onboarding form, that helps a lot. Confirming next steps and stakeholder map so everyone is aligned: 

Stakeholders / owners (as I have them):
- Economic buyer: Samantha Lee (VP Product & Engineering) — budget approval (internal).
- Product lead / technical champion: Jordan Myers — product requirements + pilot success criteria.
- Procurement owner: Priya Shah — vendor onboarding + PO issuance.
- Legal: Alan Chu — MSA redlines.
- Onboarding / Customer Success (Redwood): Laura Bennett — post-PO onboarding, billing contact.
- Technical escalation (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra — architecture, SSO, security deep-dive.

Open items for Acme to confirm:
1) Final list of stakeholders who need to be on the procurement kickoff.
2) PO terms preference (Net 30 vs Net 45) and any invoice requirements/fields.
3) Any additional security artifacts required beyond the packet we shared (we can surface SOC 2, penetration test summary, dataflow diagrams).

Attached: redwood_security_packet.pdf (for Priya/Alan) and the MSA draft. We'll also upload the same materials to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcAcmeEvaluation

Proposed procurement kickoff (30 min): Wed 2027-04-07 10:00 PT. If that works Priya and Alan I’ll send an invite and include a short agenda (onboarding checklist + MSA timeline + PO terms).

Thanks — happy to jump on a brief call to go line-by-line through the onboarding form if helpful.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-fintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Alan Chu <alan.chu@acme-fintech.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme FinTech - Redwood evaluation & procurement timeline

Thanks Marissa and Jordan — procurement confirmed we received the onboarding form and the security packet. A few quick items from procurement: 

1) PO timing: we are tracking for a PO issuance target of 2027-05-06, contingent on legal signoff of the MSA and having Redwood's W-9 + bank wiring details.
2) Payment terms: Acme prefers Net 30. Please confirm Redwood can invoice net30 and provide the invoice remit-to address.
3) Vendor documents: the onboarding form is missing Redwood's DUNS and remit address — can you provide those? Also need a copy of Redwood's W-9 and banking details to complete the vendor profile.

Laura — looping you in so Redwood CS/finance can follow up on billing/remit details. 

If you can get those docs uploaded to the Drive folder and confirm Net 30, we can keep to the timeline above. Happy to join the kickoff on Wed 2027-04-07 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Procurement Manager, Acme FinTech
priya.shah@acme-fintech.com
